title: Replay Pack metadata (rpk_schema_version 0.x)
description: Normative schema for the metadata object embedded in a .rpk safetensors __metadata__ header. See RPK.md.

rpk_schema_version.description: Semantic version of the container schema. Minor bumps add optional fields.

id.description: Stable pack identifier; file basename SHOULD equal the last path segment.

T_max.description: Duration of the stored walk (s): the T of the sine basis on [0, T] (SPEC §4.3, §9.5.3).

diffusivity.description: Fixed free diffusivity (m^2/s). Not a knob.

block.description: The block accumulation of the pack (SPEC §9.5.5): REQUIRED. A constant of the pack, fixed at walk time, never a replay knob; its quadrature error is carried by fidelity.terms.quadrature.

h.description: Block length (s): the producer summed each channel's increments within blocks of this length.

m.description: Moment order: within a block the producer kept the moments of orders 0..m about the block centre.

precision.description: Floating-point type in which block contributions were accumulated across blocks.

boundary.description: The walk's box (SPEC §4.5): periodic, reflecting or finite; bounds the envelope (a finite box restricts long-diffusion-time replays). Default 'periodic'.

substrate_frame.description: Intrinsic orientation frame R, a 3x3 orthonormal right-handed matrix (SPEC §4.2). Columns are the canonical substrate basis in stored coordinates: column 3 (z) = primary axis (fibre), columns 1-2 = a fixed perpendicular basis (no free rotation about the fibre). A canonical direction maps to stored coordinates as R*d. Omit (or null) => identity: positions are already in the canonical frame. B0/gradient directions are defined relative to this frame.

delta_chi_a.description: Anisotropic susceptibility scale the Field basis is normalized to (SPEC §6.4.1); present iff Field tier.

field_grid.description: Metadata for the per-walker Field basis susc_field_basis (SPEC §6.4.1); present iff that channel is used.

origin.description: World coordinate (m) of the field grid corner used to sample the basis.

components.description: Order of the 13 basis channels, e.g. ["iso_local","iso_P","aniso_G"].

refocus.description: How the susceptibility phase gate s(t_k) is applied at replay (SPEC §6.6).

windows.description: OPTIONAL storage windows (SPEC §4.3): the walk stored as n consecutive windows of T seconds each, sharing their boundary instants; window i >= 1's tensors under the prefix s{i}/. Absent: one window.

qv.description: The quadratic variation of each channel's running integral, QV = sum (dI)^2 over the walk's increments, averaged over the walkers (SPEC §9.5.5). REQUIRED. positions: [QV_x, QV_y, QV_z] in m^2 (free diffusion: 2 D T); local_time: sum d(ell)^2 in m^2, present iff boundary_local_time is; field: one sum (b dt_f)^2 in s^2 per component of susc_field_basis, in the order of compression.channels.susc_field_basis.channels, present iff susc_field_basis is.

local_time.description: QV of the cumulative boundary local time at rho/D = 1 (m^2); iff C2.

field.description: QV of F(t) = int b dt per component of susc_field_basis (s^2); iff the field channel is present.

field_read_interval.description: The interval dt_f (s) between the walk's reads of the field at the walker's own position (SPEC §9.5.5). REQUIRED iff susc_field_basis is present; it fixes fidelity.terms.field_read.

walk_params.description: walk_params. A pack carrying n_t or dt_traj here, in its window table or under compression, or cell_size (a field grid as a field route), is REFUSED (SPEC §9.5.1): re-walk it; a pack is never converted.

substrate.description: The substrate specification the walk was driven by (SUBSTRATE.md, schema substrate.schema.json): defines the compartment ids as its pool ids and carries the NOMINAL tissue values. Recommended. No tissue value is a pack property (SPEC 8.5).

method.description: Codec name (CODEC_REGISTRY.md). 'identity' does not exist: a pack is bands (SPEC §9.5.1). Walker-preserving codecs required alongside per-walker channels.

container.description: The integer band container of the position bridge (registry 0.6): the band ranges covering 0..K-1, each {bands: [k0, k1], bits: 16 or 8}. null / absent: the float32 container (pos_x, pos_y, pos_z).

temporal_bandwidth_hz.description: K / (2 T_max): the band as a frequency (SPEC §9.4 rule 6). RECOMMENDED.

channels.description: Per-channel codec parameters (registry). No descriptor carries n_t.

compression.description: Codec descriptor. A pack carrying compression.basis or an n_t is REFUSED (SPEC §9.5.1): there is one basis, named by no field.

replay_envelope.description: Declared capability tiers and acquisition domain (SPEC §7/§11). A flagged tier MUST have its channels present. The flags are exactly gradient, bulk_relaxation, surface_relaxivity, field, magnetization_transfer, diffusivity_fixed.

gradient.description: C0: replays any gradient waveform, b-tensor, EAP. Always true.

bulk_relaxation.description: T1: replays any intrinsic per-compartment T2/T1 (distinct from surface_relaxivity).

surface_relaxivity.description: T2: replays any surface relaxivity rho.

field.description: C3: replays static off-resonance / susceptibility (any B0 and susceptibility scale, any orientation relative to B0). Carried by the per-walker susc_field_basis channel, stored as susc_path_dct modes (SPEC §6.4.1).

magnetization_transfer.description: C4: replays MT. Carried by EITHER the per-walker `bound` occupancy column of `compartment` (emergent, vector-Bloch, SPEC §6.5) OR the parametric two-pool `mt` pool descriptor (mean-field, Bloch-McConnell Z-spectrum/MTR, SPEC §6.5.1).

diffusivity_fixed.description: Diffusivity is a fixed pack property, not a knob.

acquisition.description: Certified acquisition domain the producer stands behind.

B0_list.description: Field strengths (T) covered by the Field tier.

max_refocusing_pulses.description: Max refocusing-pulse density (CPMG echoes) the pack is certified for. Present whenever a codec that truncates a non-linearly consumed channel bounds the servable gate bandwidth (SPEC 9.4 rule 5) - notably the per-walker Field basis stored as K temporal modes (SPEC 6.4.1). A request above this is OUTSIDE the envelope and MUST be refused, not extrapolated; `fidelity` does not describe this limit.

field_modes.description: K, the number of temporal modes retained for susc_field_basis, from which max_refocusing_pulses derives (reference implementation: K >= 2*n_refocus). Informative - max_refocusing_pulses is the binding declaration.

fidelity.description: REQUIRED (SPEC §9.4 rule 4). Codec-agnostic trust certificate: the replay error against a reference replay of the same acquisition, and its bounded terms. Lives in the core metadata (not the registry) because it is read identically by any replayer or bank.

err_max.description: Worst-case replay error over `battery` against the reference replay; at least the sum of fidelity.terms.

floor_max.description: Irreducible split-half MC noise floor for the same ensemble.

terms.description: The certificate's bounded error terms (SPEC §9.5.5), each a bound on the replay error over the battery in the units of err_max. REQUIRED.

quadrature.description: The block quadrature of walk_params.block, one bound per channel: 0.5 * sum_k g_k^2 rel(m, omega_k h) (T/(pi k)^2) QV_c, with QV_c from walk_params.qv and rel(m, x) = x^(2(m+1)) / (((m+1)!)^2 (2m+3) 4^(m+1)).

field_read.description: The field read: 0.5 * (gamma B0 chi)^2 2 D T_e |grad b|^2 dt_f^2, the largest over the battery. REQUIRED iff walk_params.field_read_interval is present.

truncation_from.description: How truncation was obtained: walk-free from the free-bridge band variances, or measured on a pilot subset as K against 2K bands.

within_2x_floor.description: err_max <= 2*floor_max, i.e. the loss is below the MC noise (scientifically negligible).

battery.description: The acquisition set over which err_max/floor_max were measured.

certified.description: Whether this pack measured its battery, or inherited the codec error from a certifying pack of the same fill and measured only its own floor (SPEC §9.4 rule 4).

windows.description: OPTIONAL: one certificate per storage window (SPEC §4.3); the whole's numbers are the bound over them.

mt.description: Parametric two-pool qMT pool descriptor (SPEC §6.5.1). Present iff C4 is declared in the mean-field (not per-walker `bound` column) representation. What the walk fixed (f_bound, k_forward, S_over_V); the bound pool's relaxation times are replay knobs.

S_over_V.description: Myelin surface-to-free-volume ratio the pool was derived from (m^-1).

substrate.description: What was walked (descriptive only; the geometry format itself is out of scope, SPEC §1). Feeds the substrate-bank catalog card via provenance + the Croissant sidecar (SPEC §12).

ref.description: Optional URI / DOI / hash of the source substrate.

permeability.description: Fixed membrane permeability the walk used (m/s); not a replay knob in 1.x (SPEC §7).

license.description: License of the SOURCE substrate; never relicensed by this format.

pack_license.description: The terms the pack file itself is distributed under, as an SPDX expression; absent, the source substrate's license applies.

pack_license_url.description: Where the full text of pack_license lives.
